title: Chocolate Espresso Custards
blurb: Silky baked custards with dark chocolate and strong coffee, set in a water bath and topped with chocolate-covered coffee beans.
steps: Heat the oven to 150C. Pour the cream and milk into a saucepan and warm over medium heat until small bubbles appear at the edges, then remove from the heat.
Break the chocolate into pieces and add to the warm cream along with the espresso powder, stirring until both are completely dissolved and the mixture is smooth.
In a large bowl, whisk together the egg yolks, sugar and salt until pale and slightly thickened, about two minutes.
Pour the warm chocolate cream slowly into the egg mixture, whisking constantly to prevent the eggs from cooking, then stir in the vanilla extract.
Strain the custard through a fine sieve into a jug to remove any lumps, then divide evenly between eight ramekins.
Place the ramekins in a deep roasting tin and pour hot water into the tin until it reaches halfway up the sides of the ramekins.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes until the custards are set around the edges but still have a slight wobble in the centre when gently shaken.
Remove the ramekins from the water bath and let them cool to room temperature, then refrigerate for at least three hours. Top each custard with a chocolate-covered coffee bean before serving.
